  "B_expression": "-1/(2*(1+u)**3*(sqrt(1+r/(1+u)**2)+1)**2)",
  "C_expression": "-1/(2*(1+u))",
  "derivation": "Retain the P06_W1 coefficient pair. Let z=1+u and s=sqrt(1+r/(1+u)^2). The exact increment for (z+g)^2=z^2+r is g=r/((1+u)(s+1)). Expanding g-r/2 in the family form r^2 B(r,u)+u r C(r,u) gives C=-1/(2(1+u)) and B=-1/(2(1+u)^3(s+1)^2). Inside the chi_r*chi_u support this cancellation makes the whole signed residual E=(2g+g^2-r)+2u g vanish to machine roundoff; the reported APPLIED core rows show identity defects at or near machine scale. Outside the support the host uses only r/2, so larger residuals on far-from-one rows are outside the certified core, not a failure of the local coefficient family. The square-root argument remains strictly positive on an open neighborhood of the closed rectangle |r|<=1/2, |u|<=1/4, giving a conditional smooth family. This is a local source-relative coefficient construction only, not a full Navier-Stokes or PDE certificate.",
  "inspect": [],
  "note": "Keep this program for the next stage unless the host reports a domain or evaluation failure on in-support rows, or a future target pushes the state to a region where 1+r/(1+u)^2 approaches zero. Successor should check: (1) ZERO rows remain exactly unchanged; (2) core APPLIED rows keep machine-scale identity defects; (3) rows with |u|>1/4, |r|>1/2, or large amplitude are outside the smooth-core certificate and receive only the linear fallback; (4) the analytic status remains ANALYTIC_ON_CORE_NEIGHBORHOOD / CONDITIONAL_SMOOTH_FAMILY, not a full PDE certificate."
}
